description: A vault item field's `value` holds the item's secret: for a `CONCEALED` field or one with purpose `PASSWORD` it is the password itself. The Connect API reference shows it in the clear in the item examples (a `CONCEALED` field with `"value": "mjXehR*uCj!aoe!iktt9KMtWb"`), but the generic name `value` is not one the shared secret-name rule reads, so Field.value (the output of getVaultItemById, createVaultItem, updateVaultItem and updateVaultItemByItemUuid) and FieldInput.value (their input) were plain strings. The spec has one `value` member for every field type, so a username or URL is wrapped too; that errs on the safe side. Source: the 1Password Connect OpenAPI document and API reference in spec-mirror-onepassword (2026-11-12).
